title: Text ads get less automatic
summary:
A maintenance day for affiliate links: less automatic text ads and a fix for the redirect function.

Affiliate trigger words in prompts and generated text now raise the chance of a relevant ad rather than guaranteeing one.

When no relevant affiliate offer matches, Ko-fi ads are selected some of the time instead of every time. Referral links also have a chance to appear.

The redirect function was converted to ES modules to address an export error, and duplicate affiliate mappings were consolidated.
